short_description:
A house from a photo in 2021's GTA San Andreas Definitive Edition (in its alien-themed bar) has been matched to a real house in GTA 6, in Belville. Inside the garage: notes from someone convinced they live in a video game. Rockstar hasn't said whether it was planned back then. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #7 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: Dexerto, Kotaku, VGC, games.gg.

short_es.description:
Una casa de una foto de GTA San Andreas Definitive Edition (2021) coincide con una casa real de GTA 6, en Belville. En el garaje: notas de alguien convencido de que vive en un videojuego. Rockstar no ha dicho si estaba planeado. Sin spoilers. Mapa interactivo en vicereplay.com/es/guias/mapa-gta-6/. Fuentes: Dexerto, Kotaku, VGC, games.gg.

📍 Lugar #7 de nuestra serie del mapa de GTA 6: todos están en la lista "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

sources: Dexerto - GTA 6 screenshot hidden in San Andreas back in 2021 was real: https://www.dexerto.com/gta/gta-6-screenshot-hidden-in-san-andreas-back-in-2021-was-real-and-the-house-has-a-dark-secret-3429837/
Kotaku - Turns out GTA San Andreas remastered was teasing GTA 6 back in 2021: https://kotaku.com/turns-out-gta-san-andreas-remastered-was-teasing-gta-6-back-in-2021-2000758132

VGC - GTA 6 players discover our real first look was likely hidden in a 2021 remaster: https://www.videogameschronicle.com/news/gta-6-players-discover-our-real-first-look-at-the-game-was-likely-hidden-in-a-2021-remaster/
facts_note: Nov 24: the photo was in San Andreas Definitive Edition (2021, not 2004), in the alien-themed bar (VGC, Kotaku); matched to a house in Belville, Leonard County (games.gg, GTA Wiki mapping project via Dexerto); garage holds a conspiracy theorist's notes (Dexerto, Kotaku). Rockstar hasn't said whether it was planned in 2021 (GameSpot/Kotaku): stated. We don't show the 2021 image (not a GTA 6 official screenshot). Possibly the same garage as our 'NPC who knows it's a game' pin; not claimed. Re-check right before posting.
